decisionsTitle: «Dă-i un BIB gol»: a blank bib from the desk's spares replaces a runner's number, printed or not (amending §311 and §548)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-19, two days before the race, from his phone, with the sheet of spares he printed (§444: 154, 155, 156 and on, each with an empty name line):** «trebuie să pot aloca numere dintre cele goale, adică astea — spre ex. 154 deja e la …» — a runner who registered online, whose named bib was printed with another number, is already wearing the blank 154. (The runner's name is left out here: the repository is public.)

**What there was.** A spare reached a runner only at the desk's «Confirmă aici» on a row with no number and no printed bib (§444, `handsSpareAtConfirm`), or typed into «Schimbă numărul» (§548). That box is offered only while the runner's bib is not printed, and `setBibNumberByStaff` refuses to move a printed number (§311): the paper would then name a number nobody wears. So a runner whose bib was printed could not be given a blank one at all, and the site kept saying the old number while the runner wore 154.

**Decision.** «Dă-i un BIB gol» / "Give a blank bib": a fold on the registration's page, in the race-day card beside the number, on a confirmed, real registration — its bib printed or not — while the event has reserved spares and at least one is free. Inside, a native select of the free spares (`freeSpareBibNumbers`: the reservation minus every number worn, retired or stepped over by a print), lowest first and the lowest chosen, and «Dă-i BIB-ul» behind the house's question. The question says what happens, the number filled from the select at the press (`fillFromChosen`): «{name} poartă de acum numărul 155, de pe BIB-ul gol. Numărul 27 se retrage și nu se mai dă nimănui, iar BIB-ul tipărit cu el nu mai e valabil.» — the second sentence without its last clause when the old number was not printed, and absent on a row with no number. Its two answers are «Dă-i BIB-ul și trimite emailul» and «Dă-i BIB-ul fără email» (§976): `BIB_ASSIGNED` — the number, the QR and the manage link — or nothing. The number's line above it now says «E tipărit, deci se schimbă doar cu un BIB gol.» where it said «… nu se mai schimbă.»

**The one way a printed number changes, and why it is safe.** §311 kept a printed number where it was because the paper would otherwise point at nobody, and the number could be drawn for somebody else while the bib was still in the pile. Here the paper in the runner's hand is the blank bib, and the old number — printed or not — is retired exactly as §548 retires a replaced one: the change's audit row carries it as `from` (`bibs.ts#replacedBibNumbers`), so no draw, suggestion, typed number, print of spares or blank bib gives it to anybody again. No two people ever wear one number, and the old printed bib is void; the registration's timeline says which: «BIB gol dat: 155, în locul numărului tipărit 27, retras».

**One rule on the server.** `admin-service.ts#giveSpareBibByStaff` is the body `setBibNumberByStaff` already had (`writeBibNumberByStaff`, `blankBib: true`), so the two presses keep one lock, one set of checks, one audit action and one email: under the event row's lock (§444), the current number read again under it; the number one of the event's spares (`isEventSpareNumber`: inside the reservation, not stepped over by a print), worn by nobody and not retired; the registration confirmed and real — a cancelled, expired, pending or test row refused; a printed current number allowed here and only here; the row given the spare with `bib_printed_at` set, a spare being on paper. Replacing a number is the Administrator's and the Superadministrator's (`canManageRegistrations`, §548); a confirmed row with no number takes a spare from any desk role, as before; a member is no staff. Every refusal names the select; a spare given to somebody else a moment ago, or retired, is said in its own words (`SPARE_BIB_TAKEN`: «BIB-ul gol ales e deja al altcuiva: tocmai l-a dat cineva sau e retras. Reîncarcă pagina și alege alt BIB gol.»). Of two presses for one spare one wins and the other is told; two spares pressed at once for one runner retire the old number once. One `registration.bib_set` row, as every number change writes, with `spare: true` and `printedReplaced`, never a name. The fold is drawn only where the press can succeed — an Organizer sees it only on a row with no number — and the service decides (BR-REQ-060-01). The press is an action of its own beside the page (`[id]/spare-bib-actions.ts`), an email press with the hand-typed number's cause (`registrations.setBib`).

**The card's list.** «Numere de rezervă pentru înscrierile de la fața locului» (the event's «Alocare și tipărire») lists, under the reservation and how many are still free, the spares already given — handed at the desk with the paper, typed, or given here (`bibs.ts#givenSpareBibs`): «2 BIB-uri goale date:», then one line a spare, lowest first, the whole line a link to the registration («154 → name»), the state beside a line that is not confirmed (a cancelled runner's spare stays retired, §311). Names only, for whoever reads the bibs (the card's own gate, §289).

**Left out, on purpose.** The race-day desk's row gets no such fold: the owner's case is a runner already registered, and the registration's page is where a number changes; the desk keeps handing spares to walk-ins (§979). The bibs page (`/admin/events/<id>/bibs`) is unchanged: the card is where the spares live. A list of the void printed bibs of replaced numbers, as §311 lists the cancelled ones: the timeline names it per runner, and no list was asked for.

No migration: the columns exist. No dependency. Both languages, the backoffice's plain words, the glyph asked by its name, 44-pixel targets. The administrators' guide gains two steps under «Numere de rezervă pentru cine se înscrie la masă».

**Held by** `tests/integration/registrations/give-spare-bib.test.ts` (the service: a printed runner given a spare, the old number retired and never drawn again; a non-spare, worn or retired number refused; two presses at once; the roles; a test, cancelled or pending row refused; the email by the answer; the card's reader), `tests/integration/registrations/give-spare-bib-screens.test.ts` (the fold offered printed or not, hidden without a free spare, the Organizer's gap, the question's words in both languages, the timeline's line), `tests/unit/content/bib-spares-given.test.ts` (the card's list), `tests/unit/shared/emailing-presses.test.ts` (the press's scope and «… fără email»), and e2e `tests/e2e/blank-bib.spec.ts` on the phone and the desktop.
changelogLine: - **«Dă-i un BIB gol»: a blank bib from the desk's spares for a runner already registered** — on a confirmed registration's page, choose one of the event's free spare numbers and the runner wears it from then on, even when their named bib was already printed; the old number is retired and never given to anybody again, the email is your choice, and the spares card lists who has each blank bib («154 → name»). §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 11 and the printed number's refusal (`DECISIONS.md` §311). Given a confirmed, real registration — its bib printed or not — and an event whose reserved spares hold one nobody wears and none retired, when an Administrator gives it that spare from «Dă-i un BIB gol» on its page, then under the event row's lock the registration wears the spare's number, marked printed; the number it wore is retired — never drawn, suggested, typed or given again —; one `registration.bib_set` audit row records `from`, `to`, `spare: true` and `printedReplaced`, never a name; and `BIB_ASSIGNED` is queued unless the question was answered «… fără email» (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Dă-i un BIB gol», then the server refuses it, nothing written and the select named: a number that is not one of the event's spares or that a print stepped over, a spare somebody wears or one retired (said as `SPARE_BIB_TAKEN`), and a registration not confirmed, cancelled, expired or a test row; replacing a number is the Administrator's and the Superadministrator's, every other role refused, while a confirmed row with no number takes a spare from any desk role; of two presses for one spare one wins and the other is refused, and two spares pressed for one runner at once retire its old number once (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a confirmed, real registration's page and an event with at least one free spare, then «Dă-i un BIB gol» is offered beside the number — to the Administrator whatever the number and its print, to another role only on a row with no number — as a native select of the free spares, lowest first and the lowest chosen, and one 44-pixel press whose question names the number chosen, the number it retires and, when that one was printed, that its bib is no longer valid; it is not offered while no spare is reserved or none is free, nor on a test row or one not confirmed (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event with reserved spares, then «Numere de rezervă pentru înscrierile de la fața locului» lists, under how many are still free, each spare a real registration wears, lowest first, «N → name» as one link to the registration, with its state when it is not confirmed — names only, for whoever reads the bibs (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Dă-i un BIB gol»: a free desk spare for a confirmed runner, printed or not, the old number retired, and the spares card lists who has each
